# .NET Modernization for Beginners

> A workshop about GitHub Copilot's .NET modernization tooling in Visual Studio.
> BookCatalog moves from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10, followed by Azure planning.

Read the reference guide first when applying this material to another application.
The in-place rewrite, EF Core conversion, and disposable demo database are sample choices, not universal migration recommendations.
The core Azure outcome is an assessment and reviewed plan, not deployment.
These links serve plain Markdown without JavaScript at the course's public GitHub Pages address.
This index is a discovery aid, not an execution authorization or a guarantee of agent support.

## Start here

- [Reference guide](https://microsoft.github.io/dotnet-modernization-for-beginners/content/docs/modernization-reference.md): Scope, sample-specific choices, approval boundaries, evidence limits, and current product documentation.
- [Course overview](https://microsoft.github.io/dotnet-modernization-for-beginners/content/README.md): Goals, seven-chapter learning path, and prerequisites.

## Topics

- [Setup](https://microsoft.github.io/dotnet-modernization-for-beginners/content/03-prerequisites/README.md): Windows, Visual Studio, SDK, runtime, and LocalDB requirements.
- [Assessment](https://microsoft.github.io/dotnet-modernization-for-beginners/content/04-assessment/README.md): Compatibility findings and application requirements.
- [Planning](https://microsoft.github.io/dotnet-modernization-for-beginners/content/05-planning/README.md): Upgrade choices, scope, and acceptance checks.
- [Execution and verification](https://microsoft.github.io/dotnet-modernization-for-beginners/content/06-upgrade-execution/README.md): Reviewed-plan execution, actual application checks, and recovery.
- [Azure assessment and planning](https://microsoft.github.io/dotnet-modernization-for-beginners/content/07-cloud/README.md): Cloud readiness without sign-in, provisioning, or deployment.

## Examples and evidence

- [Completed reference](https://microsoft.github.io/dotnet-modernization-for-beginners/content/examples/modernized/README.md): A supplied implementation, not proof of a learner-generated application's correctness.
- [Previous BookCatalog sample run](https://microsoft.github.io/dotnet-modernization-for-beginners/content/examples/assessments/bookcatalog/README.md): Historical observations with unfinished checks.
- [Validation and evidence](https://microsoft.github.io/dotnet-modernization-for-beginners/content/docs/validation.md): What source review, reference tests, and platform checks establish.
